questions.text: What is the value of π (pi) up to two decimal places?
questions.explanation: The value of π is approximately 3.14159, which rounds to 3.14 to two decimal places.

If a triangle has angles 60° and 70°, what is the third angle?
questions.explanation: Sum of angles in triangle = 180°. Third angle = 180 - (60 + 70) = 50°
